purpose: Teach: 玲子/聖子/茜/秀雄/浅田/川端/吉本/細田

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「玲子さんのお花教室にママを誘って」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting me to join Reiko's flower arrangement class.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Conversational rhythm, as if sharing a small detail about the day. Gentle smile in the voice—not pressed or overstating, just letting the information settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと松田聖子の懐メロを聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to Matsuda Seiko's classic songs together.
lines.style: Bright and eager, the particular enthusiasm of a child proud to share what he did. Quick, forward-moving energy. A small smile audible—this matters to him that she knows.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお友達の茜さんが今度家にいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's friend Akane is going to be visiting us soon.
lines.style: Gentle, measured delivery. A note of reflection underneath—she's observing how he might receive this. Unhurried pacing, warm but not overly animated.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと秀雄おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to meet Uncle Hideo.
lines.style: Energized, open-mouthed excitement. The quick cadence of a child who wants to make sure you understand something happened. Slight lift at the end, eager for her response.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが浅田次郎の小説を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading a novel by Asada Jiro at the moment.
lines.style: Conversational and unhurried, with a faint note of observation. Soft, steady tone—she's remarking on what he's doing, not performing. Like she's thinking aloud while doing something else.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとノーベル文学賞の川端康成の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a picture book about Kawabata Yasunari—the Nobel Prize winner—together.
lines.style: Warm and animated, pride threading through. The words tumble forward with genuine delight. He's eager for her to know this was special, this was something grown-up and shared.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが吉本興業の漫才を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is watching Yoshimoto Kogyo comedy performances.
lines.style: Light, warm observation. A slight amused undertone—she notices what he's enjoying. Relaxed pacing, intimate and unsurprised, as if sharing an endearing detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと細田守監督のアニメ映画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched an anime film by director Hosoda Mamoru.
lines.style: Warm closure to sharing. Satisfied and content in the memory. Natural, gentle energy—he's settled into telling her something good. Slight soft trailing-off at the end, lingering on the happiness of it.
